venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Tuesday 11/24 (MOD JK/MKZ; entered by Mya; posted 1:17am ET 11/25)** Net $2,384 vs target $1,806 (132.0%). Food $377; no events. Comps $46.85 (2.0%). 66 guests; check avg $36.14. Last bingo before Thanksgiving and the vibes were great. No opening bartender, so MKZ got the day started. Lower booths and bar top were full by 6pm. A stand-in bingo host started around 6:30pm; lots of familiar faces, many bringing family members who are in town. The crowd died down toward the end of bingo but picked up a lot soon after, and the space was filled by 10pm. A Jameson rep stopped in and bought a couple of rounds for everyone at the bar. Smooth end to the night. Kitchen: great job. No events. Maintenance: dishwasher still spewing water. Nothing 86'd. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Highlight: meeting all the regulars' families.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Tuesday 11/24 (MOD MD, Chef JMS; entered by BC; posted 3:01am ET 11/25)** Net $1,505 vs target $1,150 (130.9%). Food $129; event sales not reported. Comps $63.20 (4.2%) — bingo credit, manager comp, Neuhoff resident, Neuhoff employee, industry. 48 guests; check avg $31.36. Steady Tuesday night with higher volume and higher participation for bingo — a healthy mix of regulars and first-time guests. The usual lull right after bingo didn't happen; the room stayed steady until about 10:45pm. A large group of the Fishmonger crew joined just before close; most weren't drinking but stayed after close. Kitchen: John Michael held it down. 86: ponies, GF buns. Low: Taco Tuesday. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Highlight: serving new guests who were enthusiastic about bingo.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Tuesday 11/24 (AM MOD Maggie S; PM MOD Maggie H and Lucas; entered by MJH and Lucas T; posted 2:35am ET 11/25)** Net $6,634.88; Daily Sales Target was entered as '-', so no target is recorded. No events — the 'including events' fields were entered as NA, so Total Net Sales is used. AM (coffee) $812.87, D&C PM $5,822.01, Garden/6A n/a. Food $1,513.25. Comps $267.06 (4.0%). 179 guests (Tock); check avg $37.07 (net / guests). AM: mellow Tuesday most of the day; the hotel took over the lobby to install the massive Christmas tree. Undiluted cold brew is on the bar side. Coffee and tea order confirmed; all syrups will be knocked out tomorrow to replenish stock ahead of the weekend. PM: the 6pm and 7pm hours were the busiest by far, the rest of the night steady. No host tonight — the managers held down the door all night, with the floor team watching the host stand while Lucas trained on FOH managing. Kitchen: a fun night for the four-person team, with some Thanksgiving prep done as well. Low on fingerlings if the delivery doesn't arrive tomorrow. 911: Wagyu flanks, agnolotti, ground beef, tart shells, lime crumble. Low: cola dip, preserved lemon aioli, butterflied chicken breasts, preserved lemon paste. Break make-up complete. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Highlight: guests' childlike awe at the 20ft tree in the middle of the lobby.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Tuesday 11/24 (MOD Kyler, Chef Michael; entered by Ella; posted 1:31am ET 11/25)** Net $5,144 vs target $4,331 (118.8%). Food $386, beverage $4,758, retail $0; no events. Comps $135.60 (2.6%). 149 guests (Sevenrooms); check avg $35. Last training shift and first door notes. Pretty solid flow all night and heavy on the two-hour turns. Lots of out-of-towners with parents coming in, and a bunch of fans wanting to see how things are done. Top sellers: High Plains Drifter; Rosalie and Golden Cobra tied. Door: a slow start, not full until about 7:30pm, but the night opened with a lot of reservations — the most seen on a Tuesday so far. Good energy from most guests, though many were eager to get through the door quickly because of the cold. Lots of threes and fours that could be shuffled around. A couple of birthdays; a couple who had their first date here and are now married with kids; regulars and a Juliette rep with a group came by. A small waitlist formed and only one party came back; a few larger walk-in parties. Last party was sat at 12:41am. 2 no-shows (not charged). Menu count 19/19. Breakage: one DOF. Repairs: inside upstairs bathroom sink is clogged and the hand-wash sink outside the upstairs bathroom is not draining well.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Tuesday 11/24 (MOD Julian, Gianna, Joe; Chef Angel; entered by Julian Catano; posted 4:04am ET 11/25)** Net $5,072 vs target $4,796 (105.8%). Food $989; Marquee $5,072 (food $989); Standing Room $0; no events. Comps $172 (3.4%) — gifts, investors, DNLs. 124 guests; check avg $40.91. Started on the busy side right off the jump, with a handful of guests at opening — a busy start to the holiday season. Last shift of the spring/summer menu; the fall/winter menu starts tomorrow. Standing Room Season's Greetings decoration is looking awesome. A small after-wedding party came in to celebrate (married that day), and the bar hosted an anniversary party as well. New faces in the room, all impressed with the menu and the flow. A great shift overall, with two servers getting it done and a new bartender in training doing well. Kitchen: a one-man band toward the end of the night cranking out food. Maintenance: oven still down. 86'd/low: desserts. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Highlight: the new floor team is all up to speed with the pace and where things live.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Tuesday 11/24 (MOD Marcus; entered by Marcus; posted 1:02am ET 11/25)** Net $3,558.51 incl. events vs target $4,958 (71.8%). Marquee bar $3,919.69; Garden $0; total sales $3,919.69. Food $375.80. Comps $26.50 (0.7%) — community member/investor 10% $12.50, manager comp item $14.00. 97 guests (73 walk-ins, 24 reservations); guest check avg $36.69. D&C: a fun little Tuesday. Opening server training ran until 8, then closing server training. The team was down on prep, so two bartenders came in early to help set up and a bunch of juice and garnish was finished in under an hour. The night started slow except for a 7-top, handled with no problem. Around 8 the room filled up fast, so a team member moved over to serving and the MOD took over hosting; the bar top coached the new servers on garnish and connected with guests. Things slowed around 10, then a handful of walk-ins around 10:30 kept things going until last call at 11:30. Great teamwork all around. Garden: decorated for Season's Greetings. Kitchen: a good Tuesday, and the new oyster shucking knives arrived just in time; the cook touched tables and stayed on ABK. Kitchen close checked. Went well: communication, teamwork. Do better: keep manicuring tables and the bar top — clear dirty dishes and empty glassware before the check lands, and always be resetting. No incidents; no-shows charged; no-show revenue $30. Maintenance: curtain, hot water heater. Highlight: guests' reactions to the decor.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Tuesday 11/24 (AM Sam / Lex; PM James & Catie / Drew; entered by Catie; posted 12:26am ET 11/25)** Net $5,815 vs target $8,870 (65.6%). Morning bar $1,083, evening bar $5,241, Sun Club $0, Hot Eye $0 (parts sum to $6,324 vs $5,815 total net entered). Food $2,740; no events; comps $180 (3.1%). Guests 128 (20 AM + 108 PM OpenTable); check avg $45.43 (net / guests). Morning: fairly slow, with a sales peak at 10am; no issues to report. Evening: fairly steady (the form says 'for a Wednesday') with a dinner pop between 6 and 7pm and a handful of walk-ins for cocktails later in the evening. A new team member began floor training on table numbers and bussing. Kitchen: steady night with good ticket times throughout service; no send-backs or complaints, no low stock or 86s. No events. No incidents. Maintenance: nothing new. Highlight: a new hire beginning onboarding and training.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.weather: On and off showers all day. Small impact on walk in velocity.
venues.narrative: **SEA — Tuesday 11/24 (MOD Curtis Hayes; entered by Curtis Hayes; posted 2:59am ET 11/25)** Net $7,129 vs target $7,330 (97.3%). Food $1,273; no events. Comps $328.63 (4.4% as reported) — heavy industry crowd, birthdays and anniversaries, and DNLs a touch on the heavy side. 135 guests; avg guest spend $52.80 as reported. Rainy start with showers developing through the day — a small impact on walk-ins, though guests seem to be braving the weather again as they acclimate. A small staffing pivot after a team member had a pet emergency: the MOD worked the floor for about four hours until relief arrived at 8pm. Steady pace on the floor throughout, with the only lull right at opening. The door communicated well about birthdays, anniversaries and community members; the floor ran smooth with some great hospitality moments, and the bar ran smoothly with great guests all night. Finished right under projection. Kitchen: killed it — about $1.2K with ease and a great staff meal; no notes. No events. No maintenance needs. 86'd/low: Heart of Stone sour (replacement incoming). No incidents; no-shows charged. Highlight: a member taking polaroids of everyone while he and six other members held their annual meeting in the party pod.
